field_descriptions.main_entity: Name of the {entity} stated in the document
field_descriptions.jurisdiction: Where the {entity} is officially registered, if present. It can be a country, state or territory, like Delaware or British Colombia.
field_descriptions.relation_name: Name of person or company related to the main {entity}
field_descriptions.relation_address: Address of the person or company related to the main {entity}, if present. This field should include the literal address captured in the document, including c/o field if present.
field_descriptions.relation_country: Country of the address of the person or company related to the main {entity}, if present
field_descriptions.relation_nationality: Nationality of the person related to the main {entity}, if present
field_descriptions.relation_type: Type of related entity. Must be one of these two: ['Person', 'Company']. Cannot be null. If it's not clear, use your best judgement based on the name and context.
field_descriptions.relationship: Relationship of the related entity to the main {entity}, i.e. what relation_name is to main_entity. {relationship_choice}
field_descriptions.NOTES: Any other relevant information not captured in the fields above

guide.table_types: registers of members, registers of directors, share ledgers, share transfers, list of significant subsidiaries, or cap tables

relationships.name: Owner
relationships.description: shareholders, members, ultimate beneficial owners and parent companies: anyone who owns or controls the main entity

relationships.name: Director
relationships.description: directors and board members of the main entity

relationships.name: Secretary
relationships.description: company secretaries of the main entity

relationships.name: Subsidiary
relationships.description: related or affiliated companies that the main entity owns or controls

guide.example_page:
A page mentions company "Acme Ltd" and it says "Register of Shareholders” at the top. There are two columns [Name, Address] and three rows with data.
In the first row under name it says Alice, and under address it says c/o James Pitt, 12345 Sunset Blvd, Los Angeles, CA, USA.
The next row under name it says Bob, and under address 8B Windsor Close, BELFAST, BT9 6FG, Northern Ireland.
In the last row it says Acme Holdings under name, and under address it says PO Box 104, Dubai.

example_rows.relation_address: c/o James Pitt, 12345 Sunset Blvd, Los Angeles, CA

guide.exclusions:
Other examples of documents that should return "false" include statutes/articles, meeting minutes, contracts, financial statements, or correspondence/emails.
Tables whose rows carry financial figures rather than relationships should also return "false", even when they name people or companies:
remuneration or compensation tables, share-saving, share award or incentive programme tables, and country-by-country or tax reports
listing group entities with revenue, profit, tax or employee figures.
Shareholder lists with numbers of shares or ownership percentages are relationship tables, not financial figures, so they still qualify.
